6e6f2c1f-18e8-56ab-b7e9-af5f1ef15b6e.content: Use only the delivery channel approved by the user.

c11769a3-cb4c-589d-91fc-48a7fc5f4b28.content: Verify the format supported by the receiving channel before transmission.

d75604e1-1e25-5c2b-8316-3db4224965bf.content: Ensure that document metadata does not retain unnecessary identifying information.

c6dd9cd4-bbc5-55a6-922f-2b78f2f37c20.content: Apply an approved protection method to sensitive items.

b40d9699-8a5f-552e-97db-1a9ae59a9c34.content: If transmission fails, do not automatically retransmit the same content through another channel.

e0c0f0bb-e602-5597-8b7b-27e8b06ce7ff.content: Access restrictions on one channel do not automatically apply to another channel.

69e95464-217e-5620-8ffc-c5d0f20afc46.content: The local agent can record the selected channel and transmission format but cannot inspect an external channel's actual retention method.

f9492eaf-c1e8-5adc-9987-e58fcf527ed6.content: If format markers are not clearly distinguished, a recipient organization may be unable to tell whether content is an instruction, body text, or a quotation.
